# Contentful Provider

Manages Contentful content and configuration in existing spaces, plus supported organization and account configuration. The provider does not create or delete spaces.

## Authentication

Set `CONTENTFUL_MANAGEMENT_ACCESS_TOKEN` in the environment to a [Content Management API token](https://www.contentful.com/developers/docs/references/authentication/#the-content-management-api) with access to the spaces and organizations you intend to manage. Contentful Management API tokens use the permissions of their account owner.

The provider reads the token from the environment when `access_token` is omitted or null. See the schema below for configuration precedence and API URL overrides. For values managed by resources, see [Secrets and Terraform state](guides/secrets-and-state).

## Configuration

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    contentful = {
      source = "cysp/contentful"
    }
  }
}

provider "contentful" {}
```

Add the resources you want to manage, run `terraform init`, then review `terraform plan` before applying. Choose a provider version constraint for your configuration using Terraform's [provider requirements](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/providers/requirements).

## Use the examples

Resource and data-source examples are reference snippets to add to a configuration with this provider. Declare the `var.*` inputs or replace them with your existing IDs and values. Examples that reference another resource require that resource in the same configuration.

Import examples show alternatives: choose one import block or the CLI command for each object. Match the resource address and Contentful IDs to your configuration, and review the plan for changes as well as imports. Shell examples use environment variables such as `CONTENTFUL_SPACE_ID` as placeholders; these are separate from Terraform input variables.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `access_token` (String, Sensitive) Contentful Management API access token. Set this attribute or the `CONTENTFUL_MANAGEMENT_ACCESS_TOKEN` environment variable. A non-null configured value takes precedence, including an empty string. The token must be known and non-empty when Terraform configures the provider.
- `url` (String) Contentful Management API base URL. Set this attribute or the `CONTENTFUL_URL` environment variable. A non-null configured value takes precedence. If neither source supplies a URL, or the resolved value is empty, the provider uses the public Contentful Management API.
